description: Max-empty-sphere internal cavity probe at the translocation core center for SLC10A7 vs NTCP
code:
import requests, os, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.chdir('/tmp')
def get(u): return requests.get(u,timeout=90).content
open('AF.pdb','wb').write(get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q0GE19-F1-model_v6.pdb'))
open('7ZYI.pdb','wb').write(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/7ZYI.pdb'))
fa={k:get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta').decode() for k,a in [('A7','Q0GE19'),('A1','Q14973')]}
seqs={k:''.join(l.strip() for l in v.splitlines() if not l.startswith('>')) for k,v in fa.items()}
aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def allatoms(fn,ch):
    xyz=[]
    for l in open(fn):
        if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[21]==ch and l[17:20].strip() in aa3 and l[12:14]!=' H' and l[76:78].strip()!='H':
            xyz.append([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return np.array(xyz)
def ca(fn,ch):
    d={}
    for l in open(fn):
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and l[12:16].strip()=='CA' and l[21]==ch and l[17:20].strip() in aa3:
            d[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return d
atN=allatoms('7ZYI.pdb','A'); atA=allatoms('AF.pdb','A')
caN=ca('7ZYI.pdb','A'); caA=ca('AF.pdb','A')

# center = centroid of NTCP Na-site residues' CA (defines the translocation core center)
core_res=[68,99,105,119,123,257]
centerN=np.mean([caN[r] for r in core_res],axis=0)

def max_empty_sphere(atoms, center, span=9, step=0.75, rprobe_max=6):
    # grid search for the largest empty sphere whose center is 'internal'
    best=(-1,None)
    grid=np.arange(-span,span+1e-9,step)
    for dx in grid:
        for dy in grid:
            for dz in grid:
                p=center+np.array([dx,dy,dz])
                dists=np.linalg.norm(atoms-p,axis=1)
                dmin=dists.min()
                if dmin<=best[0]: continue
                # internal check: atoms present on >=5 of 6 axis directions within 10A
                near=atoms[dists<11]
                if len(near)<12: continue
                v=near-p
                pos=[ (v[:,0]>1).any(),(v[:,0]<-1).any(),(v[:,1]>1).any(),(v[:,1]<-1).any(),(v[:,2]>1).any(),(v[:,2]<-1).any() ]
                if sum(pos)>=6:
                    best=(dmin,p)
    r=best[0]-1.6  # subtract ~vdW to get accessible pore radius
    return max(r,0), best[0], best[1]
rN,dN,pN=max_empty_sphere(atN, centerN)
# For SLC10A7, transform model atoms into NTCP frame using iteration-2 core transform, OR just compute in its own frame around its own core centroid.
# Use its own core centroid via sequence-aligned equivalents:
# aligned A7 residues for the 6 NTCP core res (from iter1): 114? etc. Use mapped: 114,120,135,139,267 and skip Gln68(gap)
a7_core=[114,120,135,139,267]
centerA=np.mean([caA[r] for r in a7_core if r in caA],axis=0)
rA,dA,pA=max_empty_sphere(atA, centerA)
print(f"NTCP 7ZYI: internal cavity radius ~{rN:.2f} A (nearest-atom {dN:.2f} A) at core center")
print(f"SLC10A7 AF: internal cavity radius ~{rA:.2f} A (nearest-atom {dA:.2f} A) at core center")

# Also: count polar/charged residues lining each core center (within 8A of cavity point)
def lining(fn,ch,p):
    res={}
    for l in open(fn):
        if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[21]==ch and l[17:20].strip() in aa3:
            x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            if np.linalg.norm(x-p)<8:
                res[int(l[22:26])]=aa3[l[17:20].strip()]
    return res
linN=lining('7ZYI.pdb','A',pN); linA=lining('AF.pdb','A',pA)
polar=set('STNQYHRKDECW')
print(f"\nNTCP cavity-lining residues (<8A): {len(linN)} total, {sum(1 for v in linN.values() if v in polar)} polar/charged")
print(f"SLC10A7 cavity-lining residues (<8A): {len(linA)} total, {sum(1 for v in linA.values() if v in polar)} polar/charged")
print("SLC10A7 lining polar residues:", sorted([f'{v}{k}' for k,v in linA.items() if v in polar], key=lambda s:int(s[1:])))

# figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(5,4))
ax.bar(['NTCP\n(7ZYI)','SLC10A7\n(AF model)'],[rN,rA],color=['#4C72B0','#C44E52'])
ax.set_ylabel('Internal cavity radius at core center (Å)')
ax.set_title('Central translocation cavity: present in both\n(max-empty-sphere probe at Na-site core)')
for i,v in enumerate([rN,rA]): ax.text(i,v+0.02,f'{v:.2f} Å',ha='center')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('slc10a7_cavity.png',dpi=130)
print("\nFIGURE saved slc10a7_cavity.png")
